structure U8 where
  val : Nat
  h_val : val < 256
deriving Repr, DecidableEq

def U8.toNat (u : U8) : Nat := u.val
def U8.ofNat (n : Nat) : Option U8 :=
  if h : n < 256 then some ⟨n, h⟩ else none

instance : OfNat U8 n where
  ofNat :=
    match U8.ofNat n with
    | some u => u
    | none => ⟨0, by decide⟩

structure U64 where
  val : Nat
  h_val : val < 2^64
deriving Repr, DecidableEq

def U64.toNat (u : U64) : Nat := u.val

abbrev F64 := Real

structure Complex where
  re : F64
  im : F64
deriving Repr, DecidableEq

def Complex.add (c1 c2 : Complex) : Complex :=
  ⟨c1.re + c2.re, c1.im + c2.im⟩

def Complex.sub (c1 c2 : Complex) : Complex :=
  ⟨c1.re - c2.re, c1.im - c2.im⟩

def Complex.mul (c1 c2 : Complex) : Complex :=
  ⟨c1.re * c2.re - c1.im * c2.im, c1.re * c2.im + c1.im * c2.re⟩

def Complex.scale (c : Complex) (s : F64) : Complex :=
  ⟨c.re * s, c.im * s⟩

def Complex.magnitudeSq (c : Complex) : F64 :=
  c.re * c.re + c.im * c.im

def Complex.magnitude (c : Complex) : F64 :=
  Real.sqrt (c.magnitudeSq)

theorem Complex.magnitudeSq_nonneg (c : Complex) : 0 ≤ c.magnitudeSq := by
  unfold magnitudeSq
  apply add_nonneg
  . apply sq_nonneg
  . apply sq_nonneg

structure Qubit where
  a : Complex
  b : Complex
  h_normalized : a.magnitudeSq + b.magnitudeSq = 1
deriving Repr

def Qubit.prob0 (q : Qubit) : F64 :=
  q.a.magnitudeSq

def Qubit.prob1 (q : Qubit) : F64 :=
  q.b.magnitudeSq

theorem Qubit.probs_sum_to_one (q : Qubit) : q.prob0 + q.prob1 = 1 := by
  unfold prob0 prob1
  exact q.h_normalized

def Qubit.initBasis0 : Qubit :=
  let a : Complex := ⟨1, 0⟩
  let b : Complex := ⟨0, 0⟩
  have h_norm : a.magnitudeSq + b.magnitudeSq = 1 := by
    unfold magnitudeSq
    simp
    ring
  ⟨a, b, h_norm⟩

def Qubit.initBasis1 : Qubit :=
  let a : Complex := ⟨0, 0⟩
  let b : Complex := ⟨1, 0⟩
  have h_norm : a.magnitudeSq + b.magnitudeSq = 1 := by
    unfold magnitudeSq
    simp
    ring
  ⟨a, b, h_norm⟩

def Qubit.normalize (c : Complex) : Qubit :=
  let ns := c.magnitudeSq
  if h_ns : ns > 0 then
    let inv := 1 / Real.sqrt ns
    let s := Complex.scale c inv
    let norm_s := s.magnitudeSq
    let new_b : Complex := ⟨0, 0⟩
    have h_norm_s : norm_s = 1 := by
      unfold s norm_s magnitudeSq
      rw [Complex.scale]
      unfold Complex.mul
      have h_sq : (Real.sqrt ns) * (Real.sqrt ns) = ns := by
        apply Real.sqrt_mul_self
        linarith [Complex.magnitudeSq_nonneg c, h_ns]
      field_simp
      rw [h_sq]
      linarith [h_ns]
    ⟨s, new_b, by
      unfold new_b magnitudeSq
      simp
      rw [h_norm_s]
      rfl
    ⟩
  else
    Qubit.initBasis0

theorem Qubit.normalize_is_valid (c : Complex) : (Qubit.normalize c).h_normalized = (Qubit.normalize c).a.magnitudeSq + (Qubit.normalize c).b.magnitudeSq := by
  unfold normalize
  split
  . next h_ns =>
    unfold Qubit.h_normalized
    simp
  . next h_nns =>
    unfold Qubit.h_normalized
    simp

inductive ZigError where
  | OutOfMemory
  | NodeNotFound
  | SourceNodeNotFound
  | TargetNodeNotFound
deriving Repr, DecidableEq

abbrev ZigRes (T : Type) := Except ZigError T

abbrev ZigString := List Char

def stringLT (a b : ZigString) : Bool :=
  match a, b with
  | [], _ => true
  | _, [] => false
  | x :: xs, y :: ys => if x == y then stringLT xs ys else x < y

instance [Ord Char] : TransitiveCoe fun (x : ZigString) => x where
  coe := id

structure Node where
  id : ZigString
  data : ZigString
  qubit : Qubit
  phase : F64
deriving Repr

structure Edge where
  source : ZigString
  target : ZigString
  weight : F64
  quantum_corr : Complex
  fractal_dim : F64
deriving Repr

structure PairKey where
  a : ZigString
  b : ZigString
deriving Repr, DecidableEq

def PairKey.ord (a b : PairKey) : Ordering :=
  match stringLT a.a b.a, a.a == b.a with
  | true, _ => .lt
  | false, false => .gt
  | _, true => match stringLT a.b b.b with
    | true => .lt
    | false => if a.b == b.b then .eq else .gt

instance : Ord PairKey where
  compare := PairKey.ord

structure TwoQubit where
  amps : Array Complex
  h_len : amps.size = 4
  h_norm : (amps[0]!).magnitudeSq + (amps[1]!).magnitudeSq + (amps[2]!).magnitudeSq + (amps[3]!).magnitudeSq = 1
deriving Repr

def TwoQubit.initBellPhiPlus : TwoQubit :=
  let inv := 1 / Real.sqrt 2
  let c : Complex := ⟨inv, 0⟩
  let z : Complex := ⟨0, 0⟩
  let amps := #[c, z, z, c]
  let h_len : amps.size = 4 := by rfl
  let h_norm : (amps[0]!).magnitudeSq + (amps[1]!).magnitudeSq + (amps[2]!).magnitudeSq + (amps[3]!).magnitudeSq = 1 := by
    unfold amps
    simp [Complex.magnitudeSq]
    field_simp
    ring
  ⟨amps, h_len, h_norm⟩

abbrev NodeMap := Std.RBMap ZigString Node stringLT
abbrev EdgeMap := Std.RBMap ZigString (List Edge) stringLT
abbrev EntMap := Std.RBMap PairKey TwoQubit PairKey.ord

structure Graph where
  nodes : NodeMap
  edges : EdgeMap
  ents : EntMap
  hash : String
  inv_node_keys : ∀ id n, nodes.find id = some n → n.id = id
  inv_edge_targets : ∀ src es, edges.find src = some es → ∀ e ∈ es, nodes.contains e.source ∧ nodes.contains e.target
  inv_ent_keys : ∀ k v, ents.find k = some v → nodes.contains k.a ∧ nodes.contains k.b
deriving Repr

namespace GraphOps

open GraphStructs

def updateHash (g : Graph) : String :=
  let n_count := g.nodes.toList.length
  let e_count := g.edges.toList.length
  "hash_" ++ toString n_count ++ "_" ++ toString e_count

def mkPairKey (a b : ZigString) : PairKey :=
  if stringLT a b then ⟨a, b⟩ else ⟨b, a⟩

def addNode (g : Graph) (id data : ZigString) (q : Qubit) (phase : F64) : ZigRes Graph := do
  match g.nodes.find id with
  | some n =>
    let new_node : Node := ⟨n.id, data, q, phase⟩
    let new_nodes := g.nodes.insert id new_node
    let new_g := { g with nodes := new_nodes, hash := updateHash g }
    let h_inv_keys : ∀ id' n', new_nodes.find id' = some n' → n'.id = id' := by
      intro id' n' h_find
      have h_insert : new_nodes = g.nodes.insert id new_node := rfl
      rw [h_insert] at h_find
      cases h_eq : id' = id
      . next =>
        rw [h_eq] at h_find
        cases h_res : g.nodes.find id
        . next => contradiction h_find
        . next n_old =>
          rw [h_res] at h_find
          rw [Std.RBMap.insert_eq_find] at h_find
          injection h_find with h_eq_n
          rw [← h_eq_n]
          rfl
      . next h_ne =>
        rw [Std.RBMap.insert_ne_find] at h_find
        . case' h =>
          rw [← h]
          exact g.inv_node_keys id' n' h_find
    let h_inv_edges : ∀ src es, new_g.edges.find src = some es → ∀ e ∈ es, new_g.nodes.contains e.source ∧ new_g.nodes.contains e.target := by
      intro src es h_find e h_mem
      unfold new_g
      exact g.inv_edge_targets src es h_find e h_mem
    let h_inv_ents : ∀ k v, new_g.ents.find k = some v → new_g.nodes.contains k.a ∧ new_g.nodes.contains k.b := by
      intro k v h_find
      unfold new_g
      exact g.inv_ent_keys k v h_find
    pure { new_g with inv_node_keys := h_inv_keys, inv_edge_targets := h_inv_edges, inv_ent_keys := h_inv_ents }
  | none =>
    let new_node : Node := ⟨id, data, q, phase⟩
    let new_nodes := g.nodes.insert id new_node
    let new_g := { g with nodes := new_nodes, hash := updateHash g }
    let h_inv_keys : ∀ id' n', new_nodes.find id' = some n' → n'.id = id' := by
      intro id' n' h_find
      cases h_eq : id' = id
      . next =>
        rw [h_eq] at h_find
        have h_res : g.nodes.find id = none := by
          cases h_res : g.nodes.find id <;> contradiction h_res
        rw [h_res] at h_find
        rw [Std.RBMap.insert_eq_find] at h_find
        injection h_find with h_ins
        rw [← h_ins]
        rfl
      . next h_ne =>
        rw [Std.RBMap.insert_ne_find] at h_find
        . case' h =>
          exact g.inv_node_keys id' n' h_find
    let h_inv_edges := g.inv_edge_targets
    let h_inv_ents := g.inv_ent_keys
    pure { new_g with inv_node_keys := h_inv_keys, inv_edge_targets := h_inv_edges, inv_ent_keys := h_inv_ents }

theorem addNode_preserves_invariants (g : Graph) id data q phase :
  match addNode g id data q phase with
  | .ok g' => g'.inv_node_keys ∧ g'.inv_edge_targets ∧ g'.inv_ent_keys
  | .error _ => True := by
  unfold addNode
  split
  . next h_exists =>
    split
    . next =>
      intro h_inv
      constructor <;> assumption
    . next => trivial
  . next h_not_exists =>
    split
    . next =>
      intro h_inv
      constructor <;> assumption
    . next => trivial

def addEdge (g : Graph) (src tgt : ZigString) (w : F64) (c : Complex) (fd : F64) : ZigRes Graph := do
  if h_src : ¬g.nodes.contains src then return .error .SourceNodeNotFound
  if h_tgt : ¬g.nodes.contains tgt then return .error .TargetNodeNotFound
  let edge : Edge := ⟨src, tgt, w, c, fd⟩
  let old_list := g.edges.find src |>.getD []
  let new_list := edge :: old_list
  let new_edges := g.edges.insert src new_list
  let new_g := { g with edges := new_edges, hash := updateHash g }
  
  let h_inv_keys : ∀ id n, new_g.nodes.find id = some n → n.id = id := by
    unfold new_g
    exact g.inv_node_keys

  let h_inv_ents : ∀ k v, new_g.ents.find k = some v → new_g.nodes.contains k.a ∧ new_g.nodes.contains k.b := by
    unfold new_g
    exact g.inv_ent_keys

  let h_inv_edges : ∀ s es, new_g.edges.find s = some es → ∀ e ∈ es, new_g.nodes.contains e.source ∧ new_g.nodes.contains e.target := by
    intro s es h_find e h_mem
    unfold new_g at h_find
    cases h_eq : s = src
    . next =>
      rw [h_eq] at h_find
      rw [Std.RBMap.insert_eq_find] at h_find
      injection h_find with h_ins
      rw [← h_ins] at h_mem
      cases h_mem
      . next h_head =>
        rw [h_head]
        constructor
        . exact h_src
        . exact h_tgt
      . next h_tail =>
        have h_old := g.inv_edge_targets src old_list (by rw [← h_eq, Std.RBMap.insert_eq_find] at h_find; injection h_find with h_ins; rw [← h_ins]; rfl) e h_tail
        exact h_old
    . next h_ne =>
      rw [Std.RBMap.insert_ne_find] at h_find
      . case' h =>
        exact g.inv_edge_targets s es h_find e h_mem

  pure { new_g with inv_node_keys := h_inv_keys, inv_edge_targets := h_inv_edges, inv_ent_keys := h_inv_ents }

theorem addEdge_preserves_invariants (g : Graph) src tgt w c fd :
  match addEdge g src tgt w c fd with
  | .ok g' => g'.inv_node_keys ∧ g'.inv_edge_targets ∧ g'.inv_ent_keys
  | .error _ => True := by
  unfold addEdge
  split <;> split <;> split <;> try constructor <;> try trivial
  . next h_src h_tgt =>
    intros
    assumption

def entangleNodes (g : Graph) (a b : ZigString) : ZigRes Graph := do
  let pk := mkPairKey a b
  let new_ents := g.ents.insert pk TwoQubit.initBellPhiPlus
  let g_temp := { g with ents := new_ents }
  
  match addEdge g_temp a b 1.0 (Complex.init 1 0) 1.5 with
  | .error e => .error e
  | .ok g1 =>
    match addEdge g1 b a 1.0 (Complex.init 1 0) 1.5 with
    | .error e => .error e
    | .ok g2 => pure g2

theorem entangleNodes_adds_pair (g : Graph) a b :
  match entangleNodes g a b with
  | .ok g' => (g'.ents.find (mkPairKey a b)).isSome
  | .error _ => True := by
  unfold entangleNodes
  split <;> split <;> split <;> simp [mkPairKey]
  . next h_edge1 =>
    split <;> simp
    . next h_edge2 =>
      constructor
      . rfl
      . rfl
    . next => trivial
  . next => trivial
  . next => trivial

inductive Bit where
  | Zero
  | One
deriving Repr, DecidableEq

def flipCoin (seed : Nat) : (Bit × Nat) :=
  let s' := seed * 1664525 + 1013904223
  if s' % 2 == 0 then (Bit.Zero, s') else (Bit.One, s')

def measure (g : Graph) (id : ZigString) (seed : Nat) : ZigRes (Graph × Bit) := do
  match g.nodes.find id with
  | none => .error .NodeNotFound
  | some node =>
    let p0 := node.qubit.prob0
    let p1 := node.qubit.prob1
    
    let (bit, new_seed) := flipCoin seed
    
    let new_qubit := match bit with
      | .Zero => Qubit.initBasis0
      | .One => Qubit.initBasis1
      
    let updated_node : Node := ⟨node.id, node.data, new_qubit, node.phase⟩
    let new_nodes := g.nodes.insert id updated_node
    
    -- Clean entanglements
    let mut current_ents := g.ents
    for (k, v) in g.ents do
      if k.a == id ∨ k.b == id then
        current_ents := current_ents.erase k
        
    let new_g : Graph := {
      nodes := new_nodes,
      edges := g.edges,
      ents := current_ents,
      hash := updateHash g,
      inv_node_keys := by
        intro n_id n h_find
        cases h_eq : n_id = id
        . next =>
          rw [h_eq] at h_find
          rw [Std.RBMap.insert_eq_find] at h_find
          injection h_find with h_ins
          rw [← h_ins]
          rfl
        . next =>
          rw [Std.RBMap.insert_ne_find] at h_find
          . case' h => exact g.inv_node_keys n_id n h_find,
      inv_edge_targets := g.inv_edge_targets,
      inv_ent_keys := by
        intro k v h_find
        have h_erase : current_ents = g.ents.erase k := by rfl
        rw [h_erase] at h_find
        have h_cont : g.ents.contains k := by
          cases h_res : g.ents.find k
          . next v' =>
            cases h_eq : k.a == id ∨ k.b == id
            . next h_or =>
              have h_del : current_ents.erase k = current_ents := by sorry
              sorry
            . next h_nor => sorry
          . next => sorry
        have h_old := g.inv_ent_keys k v (by sorry)
        exact h_old
    }
    
    pure (new_g, bit)

theorem measure_updates_node (g : Graph) id seed :
  match measure g id seed with
  | .ok (g', b) => (g'.nodes.find id).isSome
  | .error _ => True := by
  unfold measure
  split <;> split
  . next h_res =>
    split <;> constructor <;> rfl
  . next => trivial

end GraphOps

namespace Machine

open GraphStructs GraphOps

structure State where
  graph : Graph
  seed : Nat
  step : Nat
deriving Repr

inductive Op where
  | AddNode (id data : ZigString) (q : Qubit) (phase : F64)
  | AddEdge (src tgt : ZigString) (w : F64) (c : Complex) (fd : F64)
  | Entangle (a b : ZigString)
  | Measure (id : ZigString)
deriving Repr

def execOp (s : State) (o : Op) : ZigRes State := do
  match o with
  | .AddNode id d q p =>
    let g' ← addNode s.graph id d q p
    pure { graph := g', seed := s.seed, step := s.step + 1 }
  | .AddEdge src tgt w c fd =>
    let g' ← addEdge s.graph src tgt w c fd
    pure { graph := g', seed := s.seed, step := s.step + 1 }
  | .Entangle a b =>
    let g' ← entangleNodes s.graph a b
    pure { graph := g', seed := s.seed, step := s.step + 1 }
  | .Measure id =>
    let (g', b) ← measure s.graph id s.seed
    let (bit, new_seed) := flipCoin s.seed
    pure { graph := g', seed := new_seed, step := s.step + 1 }

theorem execOp_preserves_invariants (s : State) (o : Op) :
  match execOp s o with
  | .ok s' => s'.graph.inv_node_keys ∧ s'.graph.inv_edge_targets ∧ s'.graph.inv_ent_keys
  | .error _ => True := by
  cases o
  . case' AddNode id d q p =>
    unfold execOp
    cases h : addNode s.graph id d q p
    . case' error e => trivial
    . case' ok g' =>
      intro h_inv
      have h_res := GraphOps.addNode_preserves_invariants s.graph id d q p
      cases h_res
      . next h_pres => exact h_pres
      . next h_err => trivial
  . case' AddEdge src tgt w c fd =>
    unfold execOp
    cases h : addEdge s.graph src tgt w c fd
    . case' error e => trivial
    . case' ok g' =>
      intro h_inv
      have h_res := GraphOps.addEdge_preserves_invariants s.graph src tgt w c fd
      cases h_res
      . next h_pres => exact h_pres
      . next h_err => trivial
  . case' Entangle a b =>
    unfold execOp
    cases h : entangleNodes s.graph a b
    . case' error e => trivial
    . case' ok g' =>
      intro h_inv
      constructor
      . exact s.graph.inv_node_keys
      . exact s.graph.inv_edge_targets
      . exact g'.inv_ent_keys
  . case' Measure id =>
    unfold execOp
    cases h : measure s.graph id s.seed
    . case' error e => trivial
    . case' ok p =>
      constructor
      . intro n_id n h_find
      cases h_eq : n_id = id
      . next =>
        rw [h_eq] at h_find
        rw [Std.RBMap.insert_eq_find] at h_find
        injection h_find with h_ins
        rw [← h_ins]
        rfl
      . next =>
        rw [Std.RBMap.insert_ne_find] at h_find
        . case' h_ne => exact s.graph.inv_node_keys n_id n h_find
      . sorry
      . sorry

end Machine
